deliverables.summary: Version-5 source scanner now emits chronological pages, services, cloud functions, APIs, databases, and explicit hierarchy links.
Application hierarchy, chronology, connector metrics, and service entities are retained in D3 and Neo4j projections; stale cached project topologies refresh locally at startup.
Architecture analysis cache acceptance now follows the current analysis version.
Architecture projection preserves source-backed non-API features, hierarchy, chronology, and complexity-scaled radius; selection focus is direct-only while the dependency lens remains complete.
Architecture Branches uses a constrained force-directed Canvas-edge layout with arrowheads, selection-scoped relationship labels, centered icons, and no hop state.
Architecture category icons are centered within their circular nodes.
Regression coverage for non-API feature visibility, chronology, hierarchy, anchors, and radius scaling.
